IV 396, 26* (das’ ev’ imā vassadasā maccānaṃ idha jīvitaṃ appattaṃ yeva taṃ ~iṃ nalo chinno va sussati); V 358, 18 (~iyaṃ nisīditvā); Ps I 173, 4 (~ī ti heṭṭhā tayo maggā vuccanti … te hi ~iṃ katvā koṭṭhāsaṃ katvā upari upari maggena pahātabbakilese ṭhapetvā pajahanti); — ifc see yath’-; — odhiṃ karoti, limits, defines; marks a limit; makes a division; discriminates ; Ja II 18, 21 (tikhiṇavāsiyā khānukassa samantato ~iṃ katvā); Sp 893, 9 (sapadānan ti tattha tattha ~iṃ akatvā anupaṭipātiyā); Ps I 173, 4 (~iṃ katvā); — anodhiṃ karitvā, anodhikatvā, not limiting, without limitation; without discrimination, without distinction ; A III 443, 8 (sabbasaṅkhāresu anodhiṃ karitvā aniccasaññaṃ upaṭṭhāpetuṃ; Mp III 414, 19 foll. : ettakā va saṅkhārā aniccā na ito pare ti evaṃ sīmaṃ mariyādaṃ akatvā); Kv 208, 31 (sabbe saṅkhārā anodhiṃ katvā kukkuḷā ti, Be, Se so; Ee anodhikatvā); — odhiso, adv. , in a limited way, within bounds; directed to limited or defined objects; individually, separately; partly ; A II 160, 23 (atthapaṭisambhidā sacchikatā ~iso vyañjanaso; cf Mp III 149, 11 : ~iso ti kāraṇaso vyañjanaso ti akkharaso); Vibh 246, 1 (~iso kilesānaṃ pahānā bhikkhu); Peṭ 178, 4 ; Nett 12, 18 (loko ~iso kadāci karahaci dukkhadukkhatāya muccati); Vism 296, 3 ([mettā] liṅgavisabhāge ~iso na bhāvetabbā); — odhisogahaṇa, n. , the apprehension of a limited or specific object ; Ud-a 214, 32 (bahuvacanena odhiso-gahaṇaṃ dīpeti); — odhisopharaṇa, mfn. , suffusing specifically, pervading limited or narrowly-defined objects ; Paṭis II 131, 3 (sattah’ ākārehi odhisopharaṇā mettā cetovimutti, sabbā itthiyo … sabbe purisā …); — °- ggāha , m. , the grasping of what is limited; a partisan or restricted belief ; Nidd I 76, 6 (nivesanesu ~o vilaggāho varaggāho koṭṭhāsaggāho …, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr odhisaggāho) ≠ 110, 13 ; — °- jina , mfn. [ according to cts odhi + jina 1 , but possibly rather odhi + jina 3 , cf Jain avadhijñāna], having overcome the limits or what is limited (or having overcome to the full, the furthest extent); ; Ps V 24, 8 (kilesodhiṃ vijinitvā ṭhitattā khīṇāsavo ~o nāma); Sadd 496, 11 ; — anodhijina, mfn. , who has not overcome the limits, who has not gone beyond what is limited or limits; ; M III 219, 10 (bālassa mūḷhassa puthujjanassa anodhijinassa avipākajinassa …; Ps V 24, 8 : akhīṇāsavassā ti attho) quoted Vism 319, 30 ; Sadd 496, 11 ; — °- suṅka , n. , a partial stake or prize; part of the prize ;? Ja VI 279, 21* (~aṃ mahārāja passa; 279, 28´ : ~an ti suṅkakoṭṭhāsaṃ … aṭṭhakathāyaṃ pana hotu suṅkaṃ mahārājā ti pāṭho); — anodhi , m. and mfn. , 1. ( m. ) not a limit ; Paṭis-a 604, 33 (odhi mariyādā na odhi ~i); — 2. ( mfn. ) unlimited; not circumscribed; without limitation ; Ps I 173, 7 (arahattamaggo pana … ~ī ti vuccati); — anodhiso, adv. , without limit or distinction, without limitations; directed in a general or universal way ; Vibh 246, 1 (~iso kilesānaṃ pahānā bhikkhu); Peṭ 38, 20 (odhiso sekkhānaṃ ~iso arahantānaṃ, Be, Ce so; Ee wr odiso … anodiso); Nett 94, 15 (yaṃ ettha ñāṇaṃ hetuso ṭhānaso ~iso); Vism 308, 27 (ekamekaṃ disaṃ pariggahetvā odhiso mettāpharaṇaṃ dassitaṃ, sabbadhī ti ādi pana ~iso dassanatthaṃ vuttaṃ); — anodhisogahaṇa, n. , an unlimited or general apprehension ; Ud-a 214, 27 (eka-vacanena anodhisogahaṇaṃ dīpetvā); — anodhiso-pharaṇa, mfn. , suffusing unspecifically; pervading generally defined objects ; Paṭis II 130, 25 (pañcah’ ākārehi anodhisopharaṇā mettā cetovimutti, sabbe sattā … sabbe pāṇā …); — see also avadhi, yathodhika.
CPD: an-odhi , mfn. [ sa. an-avadhi], 'without limits', not making distinction; Ps l 173, 7 (arahattamaggo kiñci kilesaṃ anavasesetvā pajahati, tasmā ~ī ti vuccati); — anodhi-katvā ( or anodhiṃ katvā [ cf. an-okāsaṃ kāretvā above ]) , ind., having made no distinction, indiscriminately; Kv 208, 31 (= odhiṃ mariyādaṃ koṭṭhāsaṃ akaritvā, avisesena sabbe yevā ti attho, Kv-a); AN lll 443, 8 (sabbasaṃkhāresu ~iṃ karitvā; Mp: ettakā va saṃkhārā aniccā na ito pare ti evaṃ sīmaṃ mariyādaṃ akatvā).

anodhijina.p: [Na+odhi+jina] (pu) CL=8 The person who is not winning over demarcation by mean of separation, not winning over the evil desire which can lead to hell by means of the separation from the path leading to renunciation of desire in order to attain Nirvana. Ordinary people
a: အနောဓိဇိန(ပု)
အပိုင်းအခြားဖြင့် အပိုင်းအခြားကို အောင်နိုင်ပြီးမဟုတ်သော၊ ထိုထိုမဂ် အပိုင်းအခြားဖြင့် အပါယ်လားစေမည့် ထိုထိုကိလေသာအပိုင်းအခြားကို အောင်နိုင်ပြီးမဟုတ်သော၊ သူ။ ပုထုဇဉ်ပုဂ္ဂိုလ်။
